newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain 91-day t-bill rate dips to 5.46 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain 91-day t-bill rate dips to 5.46 pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for ten million dinars of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills dipped to 5.46 percent from 5.47 percent last week, a spokesman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Tuesday.
The average price edged up to 98.638 from 98.637 and the minimum price accepted was 98.636.
Banks submitted bids for 19.5 million dinars worth of bills, down from 26.15 million dinars the previous week.
The bills were offered on Monday and will be issued on Wednesday.
